articles.headline: Neymar injury: Santos dismiss reports of lack of transparency over Brazil star's condition
articles.description: Santos have dismissed reports suggesting a lack of transparency from their medical staff regarding Neymar's physical condition and believe the player will be ready to play at the World Cup.

articles.headline: Neymar suffers calf injury, to miss Santos games ahead of World Cup
articles.description: Neymar has suffered a calf injury that will sideline him for Santos' upcoming matches, but he is expected to be ready next week to join the Brazil national team camp ahead of the World Cup.

articles.headline: Santos manager explains substitute confusion involving Neymar
